messages:
devin: heads-up — noticed 3 customers got double-credited this morning when router fell back to a smaller seq model and streaming got truncated. logs attached, short read: looks like provisional tokens + resume produced duplicated ledger entries. anyone else seen this?
anya: saw something like this in prod-nyc last night, thought it was a client reconnect artifact. not sure why ledger didn't dedupe.
sam: can you paste the minimal log/event? which route and fallback path?
devin: pasted below (redacted):
```json
{
  "req_id": "r-01F3Z...",
  "route": "route:v2/high-prio -> route:v2/low-quant",
  "event": "fallback-trigger",
  "prefix_tokens_confirmed": 42,
  "provisional_tokens": 78,
  "resumed_from_offset": 42,
  "truncated": true,
  "client_reconnect": true
}
```
devin: timeline: initial streaming toolcall charged provisional for 78 tokens, client reconnects, router switches to low-quant variant (model swap), resume path issues new streaming toolcall which accrues another provisional 78 and later both became billed.
jess: feels like two separate issues: 1) provisional lifecycle is too eager to mark as final, 2) resume path isn't preserving original provenance/tombstone to dedupe provisional.
kyle: quick mitigation idea: on fallback->truncation case, add a resume_session_id to outgoing toolcalls and carry original_req_id in billing events so ledger can coalesce provisional credits. cheap patch?
anya: ledger-side coalesce needs to be careful with partial prefixes (we can't assume equal offsets always). maybe use (original_req_id + resumed_from_offset) as dedupe key.
sam: risk: clients who legitimately continued the stream as a new logical request would be deduped incorrectly. how do we distinguish?
jess: include resume_flag and fallback_route_tag. rule: only dedupe when fallback_route_tag != original_route and truncated==true and client_reconnect==true. that constrains false positives.
devin: agree on heuristics, but we should also fix console visibility — ops need to see provisional vs confirmed per route so SRE can triage billing spikes.
anya: Console change: add a per-request timeline view showing provisional delta, resume hops, and final invoice delta. small badge: PROVISIONAL (yellow) -> CONFIRMED (green).
kyle: I'll prototype the billing event schema change: add fields {resume_session_id, origin_req_id, fallback_route_tag, truncated_bool}. backward compatible with new field names.
billing-bot: alert posted: Billing anomaly detected: +3 customers, delta range 60-160 tokens. Ticket suggested: INF-4321.
sam: action items: (1) kyle prototype schema + ledger dedupe PR, (2) jess/anya design conservative dedupe rule, (3) devex/console: show provisional timeline, (4) ops run replay test on staging with reconnect+fallback sim.
devin: assigning INF-4321 to kyle/jess/anya, ops will run sim by EOD. tagging @oncall in case we need emergency rollback. thanks all :thumbsup:
